common.quality-warnings-test: the SauceLabs device has no deterministic audio input.
common.incoming-call-test-manual: requires a human to answer the call.
common.ice-test: the valid-* variants skip because no TURN credentials are bundled at build time.

android.registration-test: the build receives a placeholder google-services.json, so it has no real FCM push credential.
android.incoming-ice-test: the build has no real FCM push credential, so it cannot receive incoming calls.
android.voice-api-test: the get-device-token step needs an FCM token, and the build receives a placeholder google-services.json.

ios.registration-test: the build is unsigned and carries no aps-environment entitlement, so it can obtain no PushKit VoIP token.
ios.incoming-ice-test: the build can obtain no PushKit VoIP token, so it cannot receive incoming calls.

call-controls-test.select-audio-device-while-connected: the step is limited to iOS until in-call audio device selection is verified on Android (VBLOCKS-7358).

voice-api-test.show-av-route-picker-view: the AV route picker is presented modally, the SDK cannot dismiss the picker, and XCUITest then loses the harness elements underneath.
